loadTest.title: Title of the dialog.
loadTest.barLabel: Accessible name of the button next to the request bar.
loadTest.notice: Legal and practical warning shown at the top of the dialog.
loadTest.concurrency: Number of workers that send requests at the same time.
loadTest.duration: How long the test runs, in seconds.
loadTest.rateLimit: Upper limit of requests per second across all workers.
loadTest.rateLimitHint: Placeholder of the field when no limit is set.
loadTest.stopped: Badge on results of a test that was stopped before the time ran out.
loadTest.progress.p95: Latency under which 95 percent of requests finished.
loadTest.failureBreakdown: {{networkErrors}} requests with a network error, {{statusFailures}} requests with a status of {{failureStatus}} or above.
loadTest.percentileColumns: Column headings of the latency table.
loadTest.percentiles: Row names of the latency table: minimum, mean, percentiles p50, p90, p95 and p99, maximum. Keep p50 to p99 as they are.
loadTest.statusCount: Status code, a times sign and the number of responses, for example 200 x 118. Keep the x.
loadTest.histogramBarLabel: Accessible name of a bar of the latency chart.
loadTest.emptyHint: Start is the name of the button.
loadTest.start: Button that starts the load test. Verb.
loadTest.stop: Button that stops the load test. Verb.
loadTest.running: Status label while the load test is running. Adjective, not a command.
loadTest.progress.failed: Label of the count of requests that failed during the load test.
loadTest.summary.failed: Label of the count of requests that failed in the finished load test.
